entries.name: explain_code
entries.label: explain code
entries.source:
include "lib/ai.spark"
let snippet "function add(a,b){ return a+b; }"
ask "Explain this code in one sentence: {snippet}" -> answer
print answer

entries.name: pipeline_summarize_explain
entries.label: pipeline summarize explain
entries.source:
include "lib/ai.spark"
let doc "Spark is a small language where AI is a first-class primitive."
pipeline {
  ask "Summarize: {doc}" -> summary
  | ask "Explain in one sentence: {summary}" -> plain
}
print plain
